summary: Framework sync must target a repository via --repo, paginate GitHub's path-scoped list endpoints, key commits on sha, and drop pull requests from the issues list.
reason: GitHub collaboration resources live under /repos/{owner}/{repo}/... and cannot be enumerated as a flat catalog. The issues list also returns pull requests (pull_request key) whose issue ids must not land in the issues store. A regen that restores empty defaultSyncResources, disables pagination, or stores PRs as issues would make sync a no-op, truncate pages, or duplicate cross-entity data.
validated_outcome: defaultSyncResources is non-empty; resourceSupportsPagination is true for those resources; fillGitHubSyncRepoPath substitutes owner/repo; go test ./internal/cli/... passes.
